name: logseq-normalize-scm-project-links
description: Rewrite GitHub and GitLab project wikilinks in the garden to the `Person/<Name>/GitHub/<Project>` form, resolving each owner to an existing person page rather than guessing a name. Use when a page or journal carries `[[GitHub/owner/project]]`, `[[GitLab/project]]` or another off-standard SCM namespace link, or when the user asks to normalize, clean up or standardize repo links. Do not use for link targets that are not repositories — see skill `logseq-link-hygiene` for wikilink resolution generally.
